context.question: Who will win the 2016 US presidential election?
context.setting: Democrat Hillary Clinton faces Republican Donald Trump in the election of 8 November 2016. Most polls favour Clinton. One panel astrologer at the Costa Mesa conference had earlier in the cycle, when 17 Republicans still contested the nomination, picked Trump to become the Republican nominee.

provenance.work: Los Angeles Times ISAR report via Prothom Alo, 'Astrologers predict who is going to win White House race', 8 Nov 2016
